name: sitesplat/bbtracking
description: A phpBB 3.2 extension that keeps a revision history of all posts edits and also tracks the user (or even a group) movements on the board. The revisions can be viewed, deleted, and restored only by users with the necessary permissions. Other features include the ability to enable/disable for specific forums and auto-pruning to remove old revisions. These options are set on the page for editing forum settings in ACP.
